notes: Hand-maintained input to rimpl/src/model-manifest.json (scripts/manifest/build.mjs). It DECLARES the target deployment; it measures nothing.

Production does not run this target today: every purpose is routed to anthropic (app_settings.ai_provider_*, read 2026-10-15), so /health/deep reports drift against this file, as a warning, until CCME R1 (local evaluator) and R3 (distinct tutor) close.
Never put a URL, host, IP or key here: these values appear in the drift report on the unauthenticated /health/deep. The build refuses a string that looks like one.
target: CCME on-prem deployment (docs/ARCHITECTURE-MAPPING-CCME.md): DeepSeek as the PIS-7 evaluator and classifier (provider local), the CCME tutor model for chat and discuss (provider local-tutor)

local.source: The model id is the on-prem evaluator CME serves on vm1 since the 2026-11-11 redeployment (CONTEXT.md, On-prem evaluator). Its system fingerprint has not been observed yet, so it is null; the value recorded before belonged to the earlier deepseek-v4-flash-dspark deployment. The engine is kept as vllm from that earlier deployment's fingerprint and is not confirmed for this model.

local-tutor.source: The model id is the on-prem tutor CME serves on vm1 since the 2026-11-11 redeployment (CONTEXT.md, On-prem tutor). Its engine and system fingerprint have not been observed, so both are null.
